result.rationale: The diff changes `const key = googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials)` to `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema)`, and the new helper in packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts returns `refreshTokenResponse` — the whole safeParse result object (`{success, data}`), not `.data`. This nested object is then persisted via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`, so the stored credential key no longer matches the googleCredentialSchema shape; on next load, `credential.key` validation against the same schema would fail.
